audio.text: You haven't seen my blue folder anywhere, have you?

options: Try the table by the window; someone left one there.
No, I haven't had a chance to see that new exhibition yet.
Blue has always been my favorite color.
I folded the posters before the meeting.

why.en: Indirect answer: instead of yes or no, the speaker suggests where the folder might be. B says "No" about something else; C repeats "blue"; D is a sound-alike trap (folder / folded).
why.tr: Dolaylı cevap: evet/hayır yerine dosyanın nerede olabileceğini söylüyor. B başka bir şey için "No" diyor; C "blue" kelimesini tekrar ediyor; D ses benzerliği tuzağı (folder / folded).
why.es: Respuesta indirecta: en vez de decir sí o no, sugiere dónde puede estar la carpeta. B dice "No" sobre otra cosa; C repite "blue"; D es una trampa de sonido parecido (folder / folded).
